overview: Pick a theme from a marketplace or ask us to suggest two that fit your catalog. We install it on a staging copy of your store, set your logo, colors and fonts, arrange the home page blocks, style the product and category pages and test it on phones. You skip a custom design bill and still end up with a store that looks like yours. Theme license fees are paid by you to the theme maker.

faq: Where do I buy a Magento theme?

From marketplaces such as the Adobe Commerce Marketplace or well-known theme shops. Prices run from free to a few hundred dollars and are paid to the maker, not to us. We can suggest options before you buy.
Will the theme work with my version?
We check that the theme supports your Magento 2 version before installing, and test it on staging. Themes made for Magento 1 do not carry over, so we say so early if yours needs replacing.
Do you use Luma, Hyva or something else?
All three are fine. Luma is the default, Hyva is lighter and faster but needs compatible extensions, and custom themes suit larger needs. We recommend one based on your catalog and budget.
Can you keep my existing extensions working?
We test each extension with the new theme and fix small layout clashes. If an extension needs an update from its maker, we tell you which one and what to ask for.
